📦 **meadow-specialty `9cb697a6`** — feat(goods): add saffron, Chios mastic and cork production chains

Register three goods with ecology, field production, costs and pixel icons.
Saffron reaches supplied-only luxury demand; Chios mastic can be processed
into existing medicine; cork supports an alternative float fishing recipe.
Retain original medicine/fishing recipes and protect tree crops from switching.
Regenerate buildings from JSON; refresh only the three species' opening land.
Only Seville gains cork ability. Current opening towns do not cover saffron
or Chios source regions, so do not invent local imports, stock or producers.

72 actual production/consumption/trade/ecology assertions pass. Resource
reconciliation 130 rows/111 live/19 planned, 130 images; missing mastic control
fails exactly then restores. Real La Mancha steppe/Chios positive points and
Lesbos negative checked. Species/building checks pass; mobile/native trade
screenshots confirm buy prices and averages. Historical versus game estimates
and current source-town limitations are documented.

The older Mediterranean check's coarse-climate Marseille fixture also fails
on baseline 44a4d5a1. Preserve its baseline stderr; no olive rule was changed.
Author performed QA; no independent reviewer. No Blockside source/build changes.
